deterministic_iid_null.description: Independent standardized residual returns with no mean-reversion predictability; the exact incumbent V5 PCA rolling-state adjustment gate is reproduced.
deterministic_iid_null.interpretation: These are deterministic model-size diagnostics, not estimates of the live Polymarket false-discovery rate and not PnL backtests. The overlapping rolling-state design plus full-sample demeaning induces a finite-sample negative beta bias under the iid null; the low t_reversion gate and search multiplicity then make spurious adjustments economically relevant to test.

required_common_sample_experiment: timestamp-align V5 PCA residual returns before inference, consistent with research PR #174
compare the incumbent overlapping rolling-state regression with purged/non-overlapping and block-bootstrap calibrated alternatives on identical chronological residual histories
control multiplicity across market, event and time clusters for the searched PCA universe
jointly ablate the confidence-aware singleton decision issue tracked by research PR #141
report terminal Brier/log-loss/calibration where appropriate and executable OOS net PnL/drawdown at 1x, 1.5x and 2x costs
